results.title: 2025 Watch List: Artificial Intelligence in Health Care - NCBI
results.content: :   The 2025 Watch List focuses on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in health care and the issues that may arise with the implementation of these technologies. :   The 2025 Watch List of AI technologies and issues in health care was developed through consensus-based decision-making at a workshop in November 2024 including individuals from across Canada with experience and expertise in AI. :   The 2025 Watch List identifies and describes the top 5 new and emerging AI technologies in health care. :   The 2025 Watch List also identifies the top 5 issues related to AI technologies in health care. To alert decision-makers to innovations within AI technologies used in health care as well as the possible implications for health systems, the 2025 Watch List identifies new and emerging AI technologies and the issues related to the implementation of these technologies that are likely to have a significant impact on health care systems in Canada over the next 5 years.
